reviews.comment: Modal + folder browser + traversal confinement are sound. 1 HIGH blocker: /api/fs/list + /api/projects/create are reachable cross-origin via DNS rebinding (no Host-header validation; ACAO:* global; loopback+Sec-Fetch-Site both pass under rebinding) -> remote home-dir read + file creation. Also Sec-Fetch-Site fails open when absent. Fix: validate Host is loopback + treat cross-origin Origin/absent-metadata as untrusted; extend to /start. Non-blocking: stale npDir on failed reopen, double-POST on success, symlinked dirs undiscoverable, minor path disclosure + root-'/' edges.

fix.comment: Fixed HIGH blocker + 5 non-blocking. Blocker: replaced Sec-Fetch-Site-only guard with isTrustedLocalRequest (Host loopback validation defeats DNS rebinding + cross-origin Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site) on fs/list + create + start. NB: reset stale npDir, no double-POST on success, symlinked dirs browsable, generic fs errors, root-'/' edges. 344 tests incl. Host/Origin/rebinding assertions.

reviews.comment: Round 2 APPROVED. Blocker fix (isTrustedLocalRequest: Host-loopback validation) independently verified sound — DNS rebinding blocked (Host is browser-forbidden), cross-origin POSTs always carry Origin, no parse bypass, legit hub page unaffected. All 5 non-blocking fixed. Verification surfaced 2 adjacent pre-existing CSRF/disclosure holes (register poisoning; hub/projects+refresh open reads) — closed those too with the same guard. 345 tests. Residuals benign (Safari no-cors opaque GET; custom /etc/hosts alias; non-browser clients).
